cost_notes: No new construction calls. Per-arm construction cost remains the Step100 logical cost; do not treat it as zero or sum shared per-arm costs. This run adds only reader calls. The completed4B run is a separate experimental expense, not a required8B reading stage. Source cap256 does not cap cumulative tokens, generated notes, or compute. No total speedup claim against plain_set. Historical ranking/retrieval costs remain unknown.
scope: Same350 known benchmark questions as Step100; neither new-source confirmation nor independent untouched test. No subset selected using 8B output outcomes.
interpretation: Reader-stack robustness, not a weights-only ablation: model, native thinking regime and two-pass reading differ. All comparisons between selectors within a reader use the same reader settings. Source cap256 does not equalize cumulative compute.
decision: Use as evidence about transfer of the selector benefit across two fixed reader stacks. Report positive, null or changed effects; do not retune model/prompt/seed/threshold or discard rows after this run.
